inlines.v: SQUIRT, verb transitive To eject or drive out of a narrow pipe or orifice, in a stream; as, to squirt water. SQUIRT, verb intransitive To throw out words; to let fly. [Not in use.] SQUIRT, noun 1. An instrument with which a liquid is ejected in a stream with force. 2. A small quick stream.
